formulae.label: Actual centered Gram identities on the source event

assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\), \(2q+1<d\), \(r=q+1\), and \(n=2q+1\). The case \(q=0\) is included; needed positivity follows internally.
On \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\), use the original probability \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\), with \(\gamma_j=N(0,I_j)\). The actual physical row is \(\Phi_i=(\omega_{1,i},\ldots,\omega_{r,i})\).

Put \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i=(1,\sqrt2\cos\theta_i,\ldots,\sqrt2\cos(q\theta_i))\), \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\), and \(w_i=\cos(n\theta_i)\). For a Lean row index \(j:\mathrm{Fin}\,d\), the source row index is \(j.val+1\).

Define \(Y_i=d^{-1}(\Phi_i\Phi_i^\top\otimes t_it_i^\top)\mathbf1_{\{\|\Phi_i\|^2\le L\}}\), \(M_i=\int Y_i\,d\mu\), and \(Z_i=Y_i-M_i\). All means use the same original unconditional \(\mu\). The canonical actual-mean theorem establishes integrability internally.

Define the actual scalar \(a=r^{-1}\int_{\mathbb R^r}\|x\|^2\mathbf1_{\{\|x\|^2\le L\}}\,d\gamma_r(x)\). The actual matrix has entries \(B_{i,(b,k)}=d^{-1/2}\Phi_i(b)t_i(k)\), with the Gaussian coordinate first. Put \(D_n=\operatorname{diag}(w_i)\).

The source event \(\mathcal T=\{\omega:\|\Phi_i(\omega)\|^2\le L\text{ for every }i\}\) is denoted \(G\) in Lean. The public conclusion is pointwise on this inclusive event. Matrix norms are real Euclidean operator norms.

Private consumer only: for every real \(\Delta\), let \(\mathcal E_\Delta=\{\|\sum_iZ_i\|_{\rm op}\le\Delta,\ \|\sum_iw_iZ_i\|_{\rm op}\le\Delta\}\). The norm conclusion is on \(\mathcal T\cap\mathcal E_\Delta\). This explicitly generalizes the source numeric threshold to an arbitrary real threshold; it does not assert the probability of either event.

obligations.label: Actual eventwise centered and weighted Gram realization.

bindings.boundary: Public P is the actual deterministic Ex125 realization on the original inclusive event, under the sole source dimension regime. Private T proves the actual eventwise Ex126 norm implication for every real threshold; this is an explicitly labelled authored deterministic generalization, with no public API or separate canonical node credit. Neither event probability nor a Bernstein bound is asserted. Full FactC6/Lemma4.4/Krylov/main lower bounds, actual oracle/precision/TV/dimension-condition-number/worst-query-cap/expected-cost adapters, serialized main/site/source-index/globalgraph integration and purification remain separate.
